new_deductions: The integral commutator trace lies in O_F, with seven conjugates in [-2,2] and one equal to twice the displacement cosine.
Exhaustive enumeration of 6167 real trace-lattice vectors excludes a positive outlier in (2,8].
The integral projection alpha+beta*alpha*beta^-1 belongs to O_M and has seven squared absolute values at most four.
Exhaustive enumeration of 376935 CM trace-lattice vectors excludes a squared absolute value outlier in (4,64].
Uniform CM displacement greater than 2*acosh(4), giving embedded open disks with radius squared 3/5.
Joint unrounded norm/height estimate and sufficient section-valuation thresholds 35947/36096/36237.
The same bound at the optimistic radius-one limit still requires 32928/33064/33193, excluding radius-only refinement as a way to certify the current data.
Exact storage counts for examples of the present dense moment-state design, without predicting a required working precision.
